info.title: Grade_scale API
info.description: Anonymous, session-owned course grades. Obtain a cookie and CSRF token from /session before changing data. Data expires within 24 hours. POST requests are not automatically retried.

get.summary: Create or resume a browser session and obtain its CSRF token
Read a course, assessments and result

delete.summary: Delete a course and its assessments

post.summary: Add an assessment with transaction-safe weight validation

get.summary: Calculate the final or provisional weighted result
Calculate the required average on remaining work
